messages:
Ben (Partnerships): HelioSync reached out — they want a joint POC for their SmartAssist product next week. Scope: SSO + SAML, egress requirements (they want to whitelist outbound to their analytics), pricing for a 4-week dedicated pilot slot, and a short partner runbook so their infra team can test. Can someone take lead on technical presales?
Tom (Partner Eng): I can take lead on the arch/runbook. Need SAML metadata and an IP range for egress. Also need to confirm whether they want Dedicated or Hosted w/ private networking.
HelioSync - PM: Thanks Ben/Tom. We'll prefer Dedicated for SLA but happy to start Hosted if Dedicated pricing is a blocker. SAML metadata here: https://heliosync.example.com/saml/metadata.xml
Nisha (Sales Eng): HelioSync asked for a firm price for a 4-week reserved slot (8xA100 equiv). Can Product/SalesOps give a quick band? We can give an estimate now for scoping.
Aisha (Solutions): Quick ask — do we have a standard partner runbook snippet we can share? Prefer a one-pager: how to create a test tenant, sample API call, and token exchange.
Tom (Partner Eng): I'll draft runbook. Starter snippet for them to test token auth:
```
# create test key (partner-managed workspace)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" -d '{"description":"heliosync-test"}'
# sample generation
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-3.8b","prompt":"Hello"}'
```
Ben (Partnerships): @Ruth — HelioSync's legal/sec team requires SOC2 Type II evidence and explicit egress controls. Also they asked about data residency (want EU-only). Can Security confirm if we can support EU-only for the pilot and what artifacts we can share?
Ruth (Security): We can supply SOC2 Type II summary + auditor contact. EU-only routing requires Dedicated in our EU region and a VPC/private deployment. I'll DM specifics.
HelioSync - PM: Also their security questionnaire flagged telemetry retention — they want logs only retained for 30 days. Is that configurable?
Aisha (Solutions): Telemetry retention is configurable for Dedicated customers via the Console. Will confirm default and min retention and include it in the runbook.
Nisha (Sales Eng): Pricing: for a 4-week pilot on 8xA100 equiv dedicated slot, ballpark quote is $65k pre-negotiation. I'll put a formal quote in Salesforce.
Tom (Partner Eng): Two enterprise blockers I foresee: (1) VPC peering requirements for S3 access (they want cross-account S3 write), and (2) SAML attributes — they require email + tenant_id in assertion. Need HelioSync to confirm attribute names.
HelioSync - PM: They can provide SAML attrs, tenant_id attribute name is `urn:heliosync:claims:tenant_id`. For S3, they'd rather us push logs to their collector; is a webhook+S3 pull acceptable?
Ruth (Security): Webhook push to customer collector is allowed with TLS mutual auth. If they need us to write into their S3, we'll need a documented secure cross-account role and PO. That will slow timeline.
Tom (Partner Eng): Ok — plan: 1) deliver runbook and test keys by EOD tomorrow, 2) request SAML metadata + attribute confirmation (they provided metadata, need attribute mapping), 3) confirm Dedicated pricing and residency with SalesOps, 4) block on cross-account S3 — require PO and security ticket.
deploy-bot: Deployment job #5512 queued for dedicated-eu-pilot (not started) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ben (Partnerships): Meeting? Suggest 30m kickoff with HelioSync + Ruth + Tom + Sales on Wed 10am PT. @HelioSync - PM does that work?
HelioSync - PM: Wed 10am PT works. We'll have their infra lead and security reviewer join.
Nisha (Sales Eng): I'll create the SFDC opportunity and attach preliminary quote. Tagging @Ruth for SOC2 artifacts — please add link in thread when available.
Ruth (Security): Uploading SOC2 summary to internal secure bucket, sharing link in the kickoff invite.
Aisha (Solutions): Drafted one-pager runbook, uploading to drive now — will paste the link in the kickoff invite and include the curl examples + FAQ about telemetry retention and key rotation.
Tom (Partner Eng): Follow-up checklist for kickoff:
- Confirm SAML attribute mapping (email, tenant_id)
- IP ranges for egress + destination whitelist
- EU residency flag and Dedicated activation
- Decide on logs delivery approach (webhook vs cross-account S3)
- NDA / PO status for cross-account access
Ben (Partnerships): Sounds good. I'll send the invite and mark this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
HelioSync - PM: Thanks everyone — see you Wed.
